"};

const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
function lcd(a,b=""){ $("lcd1").textContent=a; $("lcd2").textContent=b; }
function b64bytes(s){ const r=atob(s),u=new Uint8Array(r.length); for(let i=0;i<r.length;i++)u[i]=r.charCodeAt(i); return u; }
const IS_IOS =
 /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
 (navigator.platform==="MacIntel" && navigator.maxTouchPoints>1);

let currentRomKey=null, currentRomBytes=null;
function getCurrentRom(){
 if(currentRomKey!==modelKey || !currentRomBytes){
  currentRomBytes=b64bytes(ROM_B64[modelKey]);
  currentRomKey=modelKey;
 }
 return currentRomBytes;
}

let modelKey="hr16", model=MODELS.hr16;
let padState=[], selectedPad=0;
let ctx=null, engine=null, engineReady=false;
let iosPCMCache=new Map();
let playing=false, seqTimer=null, nextStepTime=0, stepIndex=0;
let pattern=[];
let patternLength=32, barClipboard=null;
let srTraceLog=[];


function signed8(b){ return b<128?b:b-256; }

// Exact same DM3AG ROM-byte interpretation as the live backend:
// signed 8-bit PCM, shift starts at 8, 0x80 lowers shift,
// three consecutive 0x80 bytes terminate the voice.
function decodeDM3AGVoice(ptr){
 const cacheKey=modelKey+":"+ptr;
 if(iosPCMCache.has(cacheKey)) return iosPCMCache.get(cacheKey);

 const rom=getCurrentRom();
 let pos=ptr>>>0, shift=8;
 const out=[];
 let guard=0;

 while(pos<rom.length && guard++<rom.length){
  let s=signed8(rom[pos++]);

  if(s===-128){
   let count=1;
   if(shift>0)shift--;

   while(pos<rom.length && signed8(rom[pos])===-128){
    pos++;
    count++;
    if(count>=3){
     const pcm=Float32Array.from(out);
     iosPCMCache.set(cacheKey,pcm);
     return pcm;
    }
   }
   continue;
  }

  out.push((s*(1<<shift))/32768);
 }

 const pcm=Float32Array.from(out);
 iosPCMCache.set(cacheKey,pcm);
 return pcm;
}

function ensureIOSContextSync(){
 const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
 if(!AC) throw new Error("Web Audio unavailable");

 if(!ctx || ctx.state==="closed"){
  // CRITICAL: constructor happens synchronously inside the trusted click.
  ctx=new AC();
  engineReady=true;
 }

 // CRITICAL: call resume in the trusted click but DO NOT await it;
 // source creation and start() remain in the same user-gesture call stack.
 if(ctx.state!=="running"){
  try{ ctx.resume(); }catch(_){}
 }

 $("engineStat").textContent="ACTIVE";
 $("engineStat").className="good";
 return ctx;
}

function panCodeFromUI(ui){return Math.max(0,Math.min(6,3-(ui|0)));}
function hardwarePanGains(code){
 if(productMode==='modern'&&padState&&padState[selectedPad])return modernPanGains(padState[selectedPad].pan);
 // Seven firmware pan positions: 6 = hard L, 3 = center, 0 = hard R (DEV5 regression-proven).
 // HR service manual: one DAC signal is switched separately to L/R before reconstruction filtering.
 // Authentic mode uses switch-duty amplitude weighting; equal-power belongs to Modern mode only.
 const l=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,code))/6, r=1-l;
 return [l,r];
}
function velocityGain(v){
 const x=Math.max(0,Math.min(127,v))/127, mode=$("velCurve")?.value||"linear";
 if(mode==="soft")return Math.sqrt(x);
 if(mode==="hard")return x*x;
 if(mode==="hardware")return Math.pow(x,1.45)*0.92+Math.pow(x,0.42)*0.08;
 return x;
}
function routeMeter(bus,l,r){
 const ids=bus===2?["m2l","m2r"]:["m1l","m1r"];
 const a=$(ids[0]),b=$(ids[1]); if(a)a.style.width=Math.round(Math.min(1,l)*100)+"%";if(b)b.style.width=Math.round(Math.min(1,r)*100)+"%";
 setTimeout(()=>{if(a)a.style.width="0%";if(b)b.style.width="0%"},100);
}
function connectHardwareOutput(c,g,bus,panCode){
 const [lg,rg]=hardwarePanGains(panCode);
 const split=c.createChannelSplitter(2), merger=c.createChannelMerger(2);
 // Mono signal is deliberately duplicated to the left/right switch paths, mirroring the 4052 topology.
 const gl=c.createGain(),gr=c.createGain();gl.gain.value=lg;gr.gain.value=rg;
 g.connect(gl);g.connect(gr);gl.connect(merger,0,0);gr.connect(merger,0,1);
 let tail=merger;
 if($("analogModel")?.checked){
  // Service manual proves filtering/buffering after U19, but not enough values are published to claim bit-exact transfer.
  const f1=c.createBiquadFilter(),f2=c.createBiquadFilter(),trim=c.createGain();
  f1.type="lowpass";f2.type="lowpass";f1.frequency.value=17500;f2.frequency.value=17500;f1.Q.value=.48;f2.Q.value=.48;trim.gain.value=1.06;
  tail.connect(f1);f1.connect(f2);f2.connect(trim);tail=trim;
 }
 tail.connect(c.destination);
 routeMeter(bus,lg,rg);
 return {tail,lg,rg};
}
const iosHardwareSlots=Array(16).fill(null);
function stopIOSSlot(slot){
 slot&=15;
 const old=iosHardwareSlots[slot];
 if(old){
  try{old.src.stop();}catch(_){}
  try{old.src.disconnect();old.g.disconnect();old.route.tail.disconnect();}catch(_){}
 }
 iosHardwareSlots[slot]=null;
}
function panicIOSSlots(){for(let i=0;i<16;i++)stopIOSSlot(i);}
function playIOSROM(ptr,rate,gain,panCode,bus=1,slot=0){
 const c=ensureIOSContextSync();
 const pcm=decodeDM3AGVoice(ptr);
 if(!pcm.length)return;
 const buf=c.createBuffer(1,pcm.length,48000);buf.copyToChannel(pcm,0);
 const src=c.createBufferSource(),g=c.createGain();src.buffer=buf;src.playbackRate.value=Math.max(.1,Math.min(4,rate||1));g.gain.value=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,gain||1));src.connect(g);
 const route=connectHardwareOutput(c,g,bus,panCode);
 slot&=15;
 stopIOSSlot(slot);
 const rec={src,g,route};iosHardwareSlots[slot]=rec;
 src.onended=()=>{
  if(iosHardwareSlots[slot]===rec)iosHardwareSlots[slot]=null;
  try{src.disconnect();g.disconnect();route.tail.disconnect()}catch(_){}
 };
 src.start(0);
}

class DM3AGLive {
 constructor(context){
  this.ctx=context;this.rom=new Uint8Array(0x100000);this.voices=[];this.slots=Array(16).fill(null);this.crashAlt=11;
  const maker=context.createScriptProcessor||context.createJavaScriptNode;if(!maker)throw new Error("No local audio processor");
  this.node=maker.call(context,512,0,2);this.node.onaudioprocess=e=>this.process(e);this.node.connect(context.destination);
  this.f1=[[0,0],[0,0]];this.f2=[[0,0],[0,0]];
 }
 setRom(u8){this.rom=new Uint8Array(u8.length);this.rom.set(u8);this.voices.length=0;this.slots.fill(null);}
 signed(b){return b<128?b:b-256;}
 readNext(v){let guard=0;while(v.active&&guard++<96){if(v.pos>=this.rom.length){v.active=false;return 0;}let q=this.signed(this.rom[v.pos++]);if(q===-128){let count=1;if(v.shift>0)v.shift--;while(v.pos<this.rom.length&&this.signed(this.rom[v.pos])===-128){v.pos++;count++;if(count>=3){v.active=false;return 0;}}continue;}return(q*(1<<v.shift))/32768;}return 0;}
 stopSlot(slot){slot&=15;const old=this.slots[slot];if(old)old.active=false;this.slots[slot]=null;}
 trigger(m){if(m.stop){this.stopSlot(m.slot||0);return;}if(m.ptr<0||m.ptr>=this.rom.length)return;const slot=(m.slot??0)&15;this.stopSlot(slot);const v={pos:m.ptr>>>0,shift:8,active:true,phase:0,rate:Math.max(.1,Math.min(4,m.rate||1)),gain:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,m.gain||1)),panCode:Math.max(0,Math.min(6,m.panCode??3)),bus:m.bus===2?2:1,slot,hold:0};v.hold=this.readNext(v);this.slots[slot]=v;this.voices.push(v);}
 panic(){this.voices.length=0;this.slots.fill(null);}
 process(e){
  const L=e.outputBuffer.getChannelData(0),R=e.outputBuffer.numberOfChannels>1?e.outputBuffer.getChannelData(1):L;
  const useFilter=$("analogModel")?.checked!==false,fc=17500,a=Math.exp(-2*Math.PI*fc/this.ctx.sampleRate),b=1-a;
  for(let i=0;i<L.length;i++){
   let o1l=0,o1r=0,o2l=0,o2r=0;
   for(const v of this.voices){if(!v.active)continue;const [lg,rg]=hardwarePanGains(v.panCode),x=v.hold*v.gain;if(v.bus===2){o2l+=x*lg;o2r+=x*rg}else{o1l+=x*lg;o1r+=x*rg}v.phase+=v.rate;while(v.phase>=1&&v.active){v.phase-=1;v.hold=this.readNext(v);}}
   let l=o1l+o2l,r=o1r+o2r;
   if(useFilter){this.f1[0][0]=b*l+a*this.f1[0][0];this.f1[0][1]=b*r+a*this.f1[0][1];this.f2[0][0]=b*this.f1[0][0]+a*this.f2[0][0];this.f2[0][1]=b*this.f1[0][1]+a*this.f2[0][1];l=this.f2[0][0]*1.06;r=this.f2[0][1]*1.06;}
   L[i]=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,l));R[i]=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,r));
  }
  this.voices=this.voices.filter(v=>v.active);for(let i=0;i<16;i++)if(this.slots[i]&&!this.slots[i].active)this.slots[i]=null;
 }
}

async function startAudio(){
 if(IS_IOS){
  try{
   ensureIOSContextSync();
   return true;
  }catch(e){
   console.error(e);
   $("engineStat").textContent="IOS AUDIO FAILED";
   $("engineStat").className="bad";
   lcd("AUDIO ENGINE ERROR",e&&e.message?e.message:String(e));
   return false;
  }
 }

 if(engineReady){
  if(ctx.state!=="running")await ctx.resume();
  return true;
 }
 try{
  const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
  if(!AC)throw new Error("Web Audio unavailable");
  ctx=new AC({latencyHint:"interactive"});
  await ctx.resume();
  engine=new DM3AGLive(ctx);
  engine.setRom(getCurrentRom());
  engineReady=true;
  $("engineStat").textContent="ACTIVE";
  $("engineStat").className="good";
  lcd("AUDIO READY",model.display+" • TAP A PAD OR PRESS PLAY");
  return true;
 }catch(e){
  console.error(e);
  $("engineStat").textContent="AUDIO FAILED";
  $("engineStat").className="bad";
  lcd("AUDIO ENGINE ERROR",e&&e.message?e.message:String(e));
  return false;
 }
}


let productMode='authentic',history=[],future=[],stepMeta=[],midiAccess=null,midiEnabled=false;
function snapshot(){return JSON.stringify({modelKey,padState,pattern,stepMeta,bpm:+$('bpm').value,swing:+$('swing').value,productMode});}
function pushHistory(){try{history.push(snapshot());if(history.length>40)history.shift();future=[];}catch(_){}}
function restoreSnapshot(raw){try{const x=JSON.parse(raw);if(x.modelKey&&x.modelKey!==modelKey)setModel(x.modelKey);padState=x.padState||padState;pattern=x.pattern||pattern;stepMeta=x.stepMeta||stepMeta;$('bpm').value=x.bpm||120;$('bpmv').textContent=$('bpm').value;$('swing').value=x.swing||50;$('swingv').textContent=$('swing').value;setProductMode(x.productMode||'authentic',false);renderPads();renderSeq();syncEditor();lcd('STATE RESTORED',model.display);}catch(e){lcd('STATE LOAD FAILED',String(e.message||e).slice(0,28));}}
function undo(){if(!history.length)return;future.push(snapshot());restoreSnapshot(history.pop());}function redo(){if(!future.length)return;history.push(snapshot());restoreSnapshot(future.pop());}
function setProductMode(m,announce=true){productMode=m==='modern'?'modern':'authentic';$('authBtn').classList.toggle('active',productMode==='authentic');$('modernBtn').classList.toggle('active',productMode==='modern');$('analogModel').checked=productMode==='authentic';$('velCurve').value=productMode==='authentic'?'linear':'soft';if(announce)lcd(productMode==='authentic'?'CLASSIC MODE':'ENHANCED MODE',productMode==='authentic'?'Original response and routing':'Smoother pan and velocity response');}
function anySolo(){return padState.some(p=>p.solo);}function padAudible(i){const p=padState[i];return p&&!p.mute&&(!anySolo()||p.solo);}function metaAt(p,st){stepMeta[p]??=Array.from({length:16},()=>({prob:1,ratchet:1}));return stepMeta[p][st]??={prob:1,ratchet:1};}
function modernPanGains(ui){const x=Math.max(-3,Math.min(3,ui))/3,a=(x+1)*Math.PI/4;return [Math.cos(a),Math.sin(a)];}
function exportKit(){const data={format:'AlesisROMlabKit',version:10,model:modelKey,mode:productMode,bpm:+$('bpm').value,swing:+$('swing').value,patternLength,pads:padState,pattern,stepMeta},blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=model.display.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g,'_')+'_kit.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),500);}
function importKitFile(file){const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{try{const x=JSON.parse(r.result);pushHistory();if(x.model&&x.model!==modelKey)setModel(x.model);padState=x.pads||padState;pattern=x.pattern||pattern;stepMeta=x.stepMeta||stepMeta;if(x.patternLength){patternLength=Math.max(16,Math.min(64,+x.patternLength||32));if($('patternLen'))$('patternLen').value=String(patternLength);}if(x.bpm){$('bpm').value=x.bpm;$('bpmv').textContent=x.bpm;}if(x.swing){$('swing').value=x.swing;$('swingv').textContent=x.swing;}setProductMode(x.mode||'authentic',false);renderPads();renderSeq();syncEditor();lcd('KIT LOADED',file.name);}catch(e){lcd('KIT LOAD FAILED',String(e.message||e).slice(0,28));}};r.readAsText(file);}

function resetPads(){
 padState=model.pads.map((label,i)=>({label,voice:model.defaults[i]??0,tune:0,vol:112,pan:0,bus:1,mute:false,solo:false}));
 selectedPad=0; patternLength=+(document.getElementById("patternLen")?.value||32); pattern=Array.from({length:padState.length},()=>Array(64).fill(0));stepMeta=Array.from({length:padState.length},()=>Array.from({length:64},()=>({prob:1,ratchet:1})));
 // Useful starter beat using category-correct physical pads.
 const findLabel=s=>padState.findIndex(p=>p.label===s);
 const kick=findLabel("KICK"),sn=findLabel("SNARE"),ch=findLabel("CLOSED HAT"),oh=findLabel("OPEN HAT");
 if(kick>=0)[0,4,8,12].forEach(s=>pattern[kick][s]=2);
 if(sn>=0)[4,12].forEach(s=>pattern[sn][s]=2);
 if(ch>=0)for(let s=0;s<16;s+=2)pattern[ch][s]=1;
 if(oh>=0)[7,15].forEach(s=>pattern[oh][s]=1);
}

function voiceName(v){return `${String(v.num).padStart(3,"0")} ${v.name}`;}
function primaryPtr(v){
 if(modelKey==="sr16") return v.descriptors.length?v.descriptors[0].ptr:0;
 return v.ptr;
}
function srPitchRatio(d){
 // DEV8 strong firmware-table derivation: descriptor b4 tracks the proven DM3AG 00..1F pitch-code domain.
 // 0x10 = 1.0x; named high/low variants that reuse a ROM pointer move b4 in the expected direction.
 return ((Math.max(0,Math.min(31,d.b4|0)))+16)/32;
}
function srDescriptorRole(d){
 if(d.selector>=2&&d.selector<=8)return 'VELOCITY LAYER';
 if(d.selector===0)return 'PRIMARY/COMPOSITE';
 if(d.selector===1)return 'AUX COMPONENT';
 if(d.selector===9||d.selector===10)return 'SPECIAL LAYER';
 return 'RAW SELECTOR';
}
function srComponents(v,velocity){
 const ds=v.descriptors||[];
 if(!ds.length)return[];
 if(v.header&0x80){const d=ds[Math.floor(Math.random()*ds.length)];return [{...d,role:'RANDOM COMPONENT'}];}
 const dyn=ds.filter(d=>d.selector>=2&&d.selector<=8).sort((a,b)=>a.selector-b.selector);
 const extras=ds.filter(d=>d.selector<=1);
 if(dyn.length){
  const idx=Math.min(dyn.length-1,Math.floor((Math.max(1,velocity)/128)*dyn.length));
  return [{...dyn[idx],role:'VELOCITY LAYER'},...extras.map(d=>({...d,role:srDescriptorRole(d)}))];
 }
 const lows=ds.filter(d=>d.selector<=1);
 return (lows.length?lows:[ds[0]]).map(d=>({...d,role:srDescriptorRole(d)}));
}

let crashSlotToggle=11;
function slotForPad(i){
 const label=(padState[i]?.label||"").toUpperCase();
 if(label.includes("HAT"))return 2; // DEV5 proven shared choke slot.
 if(label.includes("CRASH")){const s=crashSlotToggle;crashSlotToggle=crashSlotToggle===11?12:11;return s;} // DEV5 proven alternation.
 return i&15;
}
function updateAudit(i,v,comps,vel){
 const p=padState[i],pc=panCodeFromUI(p.pan),slot=slotForPadPreview(i);
 const raw=modelKey==="sr16"?v.descriptors.map((d,n)=>`#${n} ${srDescriptorRole(d)} | sel=${d.selector} | b1=${d.b1} RAW | ptr=$${d.ptr.toString(16).toUpperCase()} | b4 pitch=${d.b4} => ${srPitchRatio(d).toFixed(5)}x [DERIVED] | b5=${d.b5} RAW | b6=${d.b6} RAW | b7=${d.b7} RAW`).join("\n"):"HR firmware command high control bits remain unassigned in this branch.";
 const el=$("hwAudit");if(el)el.textContent=`${model.display} / ${p.label} / ${v.name}\nOUT ${p.bus} • pan code ${pc} (6=L,3=C,0=R) • slot ${slot} • velocity ${vel}\nAUTH PAN: switch-duty ${pc}/6 L, ${6-pc}/6 R [CIRCUIT-DERIVED]\n${raw}`;
 const ptrs=(comps||[]).map(c=>'$'+c.ptr.toString(16).padStart(5,'0').toUpperCase()).join(' ')||'—';
 $('insStatus').textContent=modelKey==='sr16'?'ROM TABLE / b4 PITCH DERIVED':'ROM TABLE / PROVEN PTR';
 $('insPtr').textContent=ptrs;
 $('insPitch').textContent=modelKey==='sr16'?`user ${p.tune}st • component ${((comps&&comps[0])?srPitchRatio(comps[0]):1).toFixed(5)}x`:`tune ${p.tune} • ${Math.pow(2,p.tune/12).toFixed(4)}x`;
 $('insRoute').textContent=productMode==='authentic'?`PAN ${pc} SWITCH-DUTY • OUT${p.bus} • SLOT ${slot}`:`PAN ${p.pan} EQUAL-POWER • OUT${p.bus} • SLOT ${slot}`;
 $('insRaw').textContent=modelKey==='sr16'?'b4=PITCH DERIVED • b1/b5/b6/b7 RAW':'PTR/PAN/SLOT PROVEN • FILTER TRANSFER PROVISIONAL';
}
function slotForPadPreview(i){const label=(padState[i]?.label||"").toUpperCase();if(label.includes("HAT"))return 2;if(label.includes("CRASH"))return 11;return i&15;}
function triggerPad(i,velocity=105){
 if(!padAudible(i))return;
 const p=padState[i],v=model.voices[p.voice]||model.voices[0];let comps=modelKey==="sr16"?srComponents(v,velocity):[{ptr:v.ptr}];if(!comps.length)return;
 const norm=1/Math.sqrt(comps.length),rate=Math.pow(2,p.tune/12),gain=(p.vol/127)*velocityGain(velocity)*norm,panCode=panCodeFromUI(p.pan),slot=slotForPad(i),bus=p.bus||1;
 updateAudit(i,v,comps,velocity); if(modelKey==="sr16")recordSRTrace(i,v,comps,velocity,panCode,slot,bus);
 if(IS_IOS){try{ensureIOSContextSync();if(p.label.toUpperCase().includes("HAT"))stopIOSSlot(2);for(const c of comps)playIOSROM(c.ptr,rate*(modelKey==='sr16'?srPitchRatio(c):1),gain,panCode,bus,slot);const addr=comps.map(c=>c.ptr.toString(16).padStart(5,"0").toUpperCase()).join(",");lcd(`${p.label}: ${v.name}`,`TUNE ${p.tune>0?'+':''}${p.tune} • LEVEL ${p.vol} • PAN ${p.pan>0?'+':''}${p.pan}`);}catch(e){console.error(e);$("engineStat").textContent="IOS AUDIO FAILED";$("engineStat").className="bad";lcd("IOS AUDIO ERROR",e&&e.message?e.message:String(e));return;}}
 else{startAudio().then(ok=>{if(!ok)return;const baseRate=(48000/ctx.sampleRate)*rate;if(modelKey==="sr16"&&p.label.toUpperCase().includes("HAT"))engine.trigger({stop:true,slot:2});for(const c of comps)engine.trigger({ptr:c.ptr,rate:baseRate*(modelKey==='sr16'?srPitchRatio(c):1),gain,panCode,bus,slot});const addr=comps.map(c=>c.ptr.toString(16).padStart(5,"0").toUpperCase()).join(",");lcd(`${p.label}: ${v.name}`,`TUNE ${p.tune>0?'+':''}${p.tune} • LEVEL ${p.vol} • PAN ${p.pan>0?'+':''}${p.pan}`);routeMeter(bus,...hardwarePanGains(panCode));});}
 const el=document.querySelector(`.pad[data-pad="${i}"]`);if(el){el.classList.add("hit");setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove("hit"),70);}
}

function findPadByLabelContains(term){term=term.toUpperCase();return padState.findIndex(p=>(p.label||'').toUpperCase().includes(term));}
async function runHatChokeTest(){
 const open=findPadByLabelContains('OPEN HAT'), closed=findPadByLabelContains('CLOSED HAT');
 if(open<0||closed<0){lcd('HAT CHOKE TEST','NO OPEN/CLOSED HAT PAD');return;}
 triggerPad(open,115);
 setTimeout(()=>{triggerPad(closed,115);lcd('HAT CHOKE TEST','OPEN -> CLOSED • SLOT 2 REPLACED');},350);
}

function renderPads(){
 const b=$("pads");b.innerHTML="";
 padState.forEach((p,i)=>{
  const v=model.voices[p.voice]||model.voices[0];
  const el=document.createElement("button");el.className="pad";el.dataset.pad=i;
  el.classList.toggle("muted",p.mute);el.classList.toggle("soloed",p.solo);el.classList.toggle("selected",i===selectedPad);el.innerHTML=`<span class="padnum">${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="padtop"><span class="pname">${p.label}</span><span class="padflags">${p.mute?"M":""}${p.solo?"S":""}</span></span><span class="vname">${voiceName(v)}</span>`;
  el.addEventListener("click",e=>{e.preventDefault();selectedPad=i;renderPads();syncEditor();triggerPad(i,110);});
  el.addEventListener("contextmenu",e=>{e.preventDefault();pushHistory();selectedPad=i;if(e.shiftKey)p.solo=!p.solo;else p.mute=!p.mute;renderPads();syncEditor();lcd(p.label,e.shiftKey?(p.solo?"SOLO ON":"SOLO OFF"):(p.mute?"MUTE ON":"MUTE OFF"));});
  b.appendChild(el);
 });
}

}

 const p=padState[selectedPad],v=model.voices[p.voice];
 $("editPad").textContent=p.label;$("voiceSel").value=String(p.voice);
 $("tune").value=p.tune;$("tunev").textContent=p.tune;

 $("out1Btn")?.classList.toggle("active",p.bus===1);$("out2Btn")?.classList.toggle("active",p.bus===2);
 $("voiceInfo").textContent=`SOUND ${v.num} • ${v.name} • ASSIGNED TO ${p.label}`;

let seqPaint={active:false,value:1,start:null,moved:false};
function paintStep(e,p,st,value){
 pattern[p][st]=value;updateStep(e,pattern[p][st],metaAt(p,st));
}
window.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>{seqPaint.active=false;seqPaint.start=null;});
function renderSeq(){
 const s=$("seq");s.innerHTML=""; const n=patternLength||16; s.style.gridTemplateColumns=`104px repeat(${n},minmax(28px,1fr))`;
 const x=document.createElement("div");x.className="hdr padHdr";x.textContent="PAD";s.appendChild(x);
 for(let st=0;st<n;st++){const h=document.createElement("div");h.className="hdr"+(st%4===0?' beatHead':'');h.dataset.s=st;h.textContent=st+1;s.appendChild(h);}
 for(let p=0;p<padState.length;p++){
  const l=document.createElement("div");l.className="lab";l.textContent=padState[p].label;s.appendChild(l);
  for(let st=0;st<n;st++){
   const e=document.createElement("button");e.className="step"+(st%4===0?' beatStart':'');e.dataset.p=p;e.dataset.s=st;
   e.onpointerdown=(ev)=>{if(ev.button!==0)return;ev.preventDefault();pushHistory();const m=metaAt(p,st);if(ev.altKey){m.prob=m.prob<1?1:.5;updateStep(e,pattern[p][st],m);seqPaint.active=false;return;}if(ev.shiftKey){m.ratchet=m.ratchet===1?2:(m.ratchet===2?4:1);updateStep(e,pattern[p][st],m);seqPaint.active=false;return;}seqPaint.active=true;seqPaint.start=e;seqPaint.moved=false;seqPaint.value=(pattern[p][st]+1)%3;paintStep(e,p,st,seqPaint.value);};
   e.onpointerenter=()=>{if(!seqPaint.active)return;seqPaint.moved=true;paintStep(e,p,st,seqPaint.value);};
   e.oncontextmenu=ev=>ev.preventDefault();
   s.appendChild(e);updateStep(e,pattern[p][st],metaAt(p,st));
  }
 }
}
function updateStep(e,v,m={prob:1,ratchet:1}){e.classList.toggle("on",v===1);e.classList.toggle("accent",v===2);e.classList.toggle("prob",m.prob<1);e.classList.toggle("ratchet",m.ratchet>1);e.setAttribute('aria-label',`Step ${+e.dataset.s+1}, ${v===2?'accent':v===1?'on':'off'}, probability ${Math.round(m.prob*100)}%, ratchet x${m.ratchet}`);e.title=`velocity ${v===2?127:v===1?92:0} • probability ${Math.round(m.prob*100)}% • ratchet x${m.ratchet}`;}
function showPlayhead(st){document.querySelectorAll(".step,.seq .hdr[data-s]").forEach(e=>e.classList.toggle('playhead',+e.dataset.s===st));}

function scheduleTick(){
 if(!playing||!ctx)return;
 const bpm=+$("bpm").value,sw=+$("swing").value/100,base=(60/bpm)/4,st=stepIndex;
 const dur=base*((st&1)?sw*2:(1-sw)*2),wait=Math.max(0,(nextStepTime-ctx.currentTime)*1000);
 setTimeout(()=>{if(!playing)return;showPlayhead(st);for(let p=0;p<padState.length;p++){const v=pattern[p][st],m=metaAt(p,st);if(v&&Math.random()<=m.prob){const vel=v===2?127:92;triggerPad(p,vel);if(m.ratchet>1)setTimeout(()=>triggerPad(p,Math.max(1,vel-8)),Math.max(10,dur*500));}}},wait);
 nextStepTime+=dur;stepIndex=(stepIndex+1)%patternLength;
 seqTimer=setTimeout(scheduleTick,Math.max(5,(nextStepTime-ctx.currentTime-.04)*1000));
}
async function play(){if(await startAudio()){playing=true;stepIndex=0;nextStepTime=ctx.currentTime+.04;clearTimeout(seqTimer);scheduleTick();}}
function stop(){playing=false;clearTimeout(seqTimer);document.querySelectorAll(".step,.seq .hdr[data-s]").forEach(e=>e.classList.remove("playhead"));if(IS_IOS)panicIOSSlots();if(engine&&engine.panic)engine.panic();}


function recordSRTrace(i,v,comps,velocity,panCode,slot,bus){
 const row={t:performance.now(),pad:padState[i]?.label||i,voice:v?.name||'',voiceNum:v?.num,velocity,panCode,slot,bus,components:comps.map(c=>({ptr:c.ptr,selector:c.selector,b1:c.b1,b4:c.b4,b5:c.b5,b6:c.b6,b7:c.b7,pitchRatio:srPitchRatio(c),role:c.role||srDescriptorRole(c)}))};
 srTraceLog.push(row); if(srTraceLog.length>256)srTraceLog.shift(); const stat=$('traceStat');if(stat)stat.textContent=`TRACE ${srTraceLog.length} • LAST ${row.pad} V${velocity}`;
}
function copyBar(){const base=Math.floor(stepIndex/16)*16;barClipboard={pattern:pattern.map(r=>r.slice(base,base+16)),meta:stepMeta.map(r=>r.slice(base,base+16).map(x=>({...x})))};lcd('BAR COPIED',`${base+1}-${base+16}`);}
function pasteBar(){if(!barClipboard)return;pushHistory();const base=Math.floor(stepIndex/16)*16;for(let p=0;p<padState.length;p++)for(let j=0;j<16&&base+j<64;j++){pattern[p][base+j]=barClipboard.pattern[p]?.[j]||0;stepMeta[p][base+j]={...(barClipboard.meta[p]?.[j]||{prob:1,ratchet:1})};}renderSeq();lcd('BAR PASTED',`${base+1}-${base+16}`);}
function duplicateBar(){copyBar();const base=Math.floor(stepIndex/16)*16,dst=base+16;if(dst>=patternLength&&patternLength<64){patternLength=Math.min(64,patternLength+16);$('patternLen').value=String(patternLength);}pushHistory();for(let p=0;p<padState.length;p++)for(let j=0;j<16&&dst+j<64;j++){pattern[p][dst+j]=barClipboard.pattern[p]?.[j]||0;stepMeta[p][dst+j]={...(barClipboard.meta[p]?.[j]||{prob:1,ratchet:1})};}renderSeq();lcd('BAR DUPLICATED',`${dst+1}-${Math.min(dst+16,patternLength)}`);}
function clearBar(){pushHistory();const base=Math.floor(stepIndex/16)*16;for(let p=0;p<padState.length;p++)for(let j=0;j<16&&base+j<64;j++){pattern[p][base+j]=0;stepMeta[p][base+j]={prob:1,ratchet:1};}renderSeq();lcd('BAR CLEARED',`${base+1}-${base+16}`);}
function runRegression(){
 const results=[];const pass=(name,ok)=>results.push([name,!!ok]);
 pass('pitch 00 = .5x',Math.abs(((0+16)/32)-.5)<1e-9);pass('pitch 10 = 1x',Math.abs(((16+16)/32)-1)<1e-9);pass('pitch 1F = 47/32',Math.abs(((31+16)/32)-(47/32))<1e-9);
 pass('hat slot = 2',(()=>{const i=findPadByLabelContains('HAT');return i<0||slotForPad(i)===2})());
 pass('pattern length valid',[16,32,48,64].includes(patternLength));
 if(modelKey==='sr16'){let total=0,bad=0;for(const v of model.voices)for(const d of (v.descriptors||[])){total++;if((d.b4|0)<0||(d.b4|0)>31)bad++;}pass(`SR b4 domain ${total}`,bad===0);}
 const ok=results.every(x=>x[1]),txt=results.map(x=>(x[1]?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+x[0]).join(' • ');$('traceStat').textContent=(ok?'REGRESSION PASS':'REGRESSION FAIL');$('hwAudit').textContent=txt;lcd(ok?'REGRESSION PASS':'REGRESSION FAIL',`${results.filter(x=>x[1]).length}/${results.length}`);return results;
}
function dumpSRTrace(){if(modelKey!=='sr16'){lcd('TRACE','SELECT SR-16');return;}const text=srTraceLog.slice(-20).map((r,n)=>`${n+1}. ${r.pad} ${r.voice} V${r.velocity} SLOT${r.slot} OUT${r.bus} `+r.components.map(c=>`$${c.ptr.toString(16).toUpperCase()} sel${c.selector} b4=${c.b4} x${c.pitchRatio.toFixed(4)}`).join(' + ')).join('\n');$('hwAudit').textContent=text||'No SR-16 triggers yet.';}
function setModel(k){
 stop();modelKey=k;model=MODELS[k];document.body.dataset.model=k;
 
$('authBtn').onclick=()=>{pushHistory();setProductMode('authentic');};$('modernBtn').onclick=()=>{pushHistory();setProductMode('modern');};$('undoBtn').onclick=undo;$('redoBtn').onclick=redo;$('saveKitBtn').onclick=exportKit;$('loadKitBtn').onclick=()=>$('kitFile').click();$('kitFile').onchange=e=>{if(e.target.files[0])importKitFile(e.target.files[0]);e.target.value='';};
async function enableMIDI(){if(!navigator.requestMIDIAccess){$('midiStat').textContent='MIDI UNSUPPORTED';return;}try{midiAccess=await navigator.requestMIDIAccess();midiEnabled=true;for(const input of midiAccess.inputs.values())input.onmidimessage=onMIDI;$('midiStat').textContent=`MIDI ON • ${midiAccess.inputs.size} INPUT(S)`;$('midiBtn').textContent='MIDI ENABLED';midiAccess.onstatechange=()=>{for(const input of midiAccess.inputs.values())input.onmidimessage=onMIDI;$('midiStat').textContent=`MIDI ON • ${midiAccess.inputs.size} INPUT(S)`;};}catch(e){$('midiStat').textContent='MIDI DENIED';}}
function onMIDI(ev){if(!midiEnabled)return;const [st,d1,d2]=ev.data,ch=(st&15)+1,type=st&0xF0,want=+$('midiChan').value;if(want&&ch!==want)return;if(type===0x90&&d2>0){let i=d1>=36&&d1<36+padState.length?d1-36:d1%padState.length;if(i>=0&&i<padState.length){selectedPad=i;syncEditor();triggerPad(i,d2);}}}
$('midiBtn').onclick=enableMIDI;window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target&&/INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA/.test(e.target.tagName))return;if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='z'){e.preventDefault();e.shiftKey?redo():undo();return;}if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='s'){e.preventDefault();exportKit();return;}const map='1234567890qwerty',i=map.indexOf(e.key.toLowerCase());if(i>=0&&i<padState.length){selectedPad=i;syncEditor();triggerPad(i,e.shiftKey?127:108);}});


$('patternLen').onchange=e=>{pushHistory();patternLength=+e.target.value;renderSeq();};
$('copyBarBtn').onclick=copyBar;$('pasteBarBtn').onclick=pasteBar;$('dupBarBtn').onclick=duplicateBar;$('clearBarBtn').onclick=clearBar;$('regressionBtn').onclick=runRegression;$('traceBtn').onclick=dumpSRTrace;
document.querySelectorAll(".modelBtn").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b.dataset.model===k));
 $("modelTitle").textContent=model.display;$("modelSub").textContent=k==="sr16"?"12-PAD DRUM MACHINE":"16-PAD DRUM MACHINE";$("modelStat").textContent=model.display;
 $("crcStat").textContent=model.crc;
 $("sourceStat").textContent="BUILT IN";
 $("accuracyNote").textContent=k==="sr16"
 ? "SR-16: all 233 public sound names and ROM start descriptors are parsed directly from v1.04 firmware. DEV8 preserves every descriptor byte, applies b4 as a strongly-derived per-component DM3AG pitch code, and keeps b1/b5/b6/b7 raw until command-writer tracing proves their meanings."
 : `${model.display}: voice names and sample start addresses are paired directly from the machine OS table. No ROM-block-order guessing.`;
 resetPads();fillVoiceSelect();renderPads();renderSeq();syncEditor();
 currentRomBytes=null;
 currentRomKey=null;
 if(engineReady && !IS_IOS && engine)engine.setRom(getCurrentRom());
 lcd(`${model.display} READY`,k==="sr16"?"12 PADS • KIT 01 • PATTERN 01":"16 PADS • KIT 01 • PATTERN 01");
}

$("playBtn").onclick=play;$("stopBtn").onclick=stop;$("panicBtn").onclick=()=>{if(IS_IOS)panicIOSSlots();if(engine&&engine.panic)engine.panic();};
$("clearBtn").onclick=()=>{pushHistory();for(const r of pattern)r.fill(0);renderSeq();lcd("PATTERN CLEARED",model.display);};
$("bpm").oninput=e=>$("bpmv").textContent=e.target.value;$("swing").oninput=e=>$("swingv").textContent=e.target.value;
let tapTimes=[];if($("tapBtn"))$("tapBtn").onclick=()=>{const now=performance.now();tapTimes=tapTimes.filter(t=>now-t<2400);tapTimes.push(now);if(tapTimes.length>1){const ds=tapTimes.slice(1).map((t,i)=>t-tapTimes[i]);const avg=ds.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/ds.length;const bpm=Math.max(40,Math.min(250,Math.round(60000/avg)));$("bpm").value=bpm;$("bpmv").textContent=bpm;lcd('TAP TEMPO',`${bpm} BPM • ${tapTimes.length} TAPS`);}};
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target&&/INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA/.test(e.target.tagName))return;if(e.code==='Space'){e.preventDefault();playing?stop():play();}else if(e.key==='Escape'){stop();}});
$("voiceSel").onchange=e=>{pushHistory();padState[selectedPad].voice=+e.target.value;renderPads();syncEditor();};
$("tune").oninput=e=>{padState[selectedPad].tune=+e.target.value;$("tunev").textContent=e.target.value;};
$("vol").oninput=e=>{padState[selectedPad].vol=+e.target.value;$("volv").textContent=e.target.value;};
$("pan").oninput=e=>{padState[selectedPad].pan=+e.target.value;$("panv").textContent=`${e.target.value} / HW ${panCodeFromUI(+e.target.value)}`;};
$("out1Btn").onclick=()=>{pushHistory();padState[selectedPad].bus=1;syncEditor();};
$("out2Btn").onclick=()=>{pushHistory();padState[selectedPad].bus=2;syncEditor();};

document.querySelectorAll(".modelBtn").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setModel(b.dataset.model));

if($("hatTestBtn"))$("hatTestBtn").onclick=runHatChokeTest;
setModel("hr16");setProductMode("authentic",false);

// DEV12 late hooks keep secondary product views synced with the original engine.
const _dev12RenderPads=renderPads;renderPads=function(){_dev12RenderPads();document.querySelectorAll('.pad').forEach((el,i)=>{if(padState[i]?.mute)el.classList.add('muted');if(padState[i]?.solo)el.classList.add('soloed');});if(document.body.dataset.view==='mixer')renderMixerView();};
const _dev12SyncEditor=syncEditor;syncEditor=function(){_dev12SyncEditor();if(document.body.dataset.view==='browser')renderVoiceBrowser();};
const _dev12SetModel=setModel;setModel=function(k){_dev12SetModel(k);if(document.body.dataset.view==='browser')renderVoiceBrowser();if(document.body.dataset.view==='mixer')renderMixerView();};

</script>

<script id="pass20-ui-logic">
(function(){
 const $id=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 function clickId(id){const e=$id(id);if(e)e.click();}
 function focusId(id){const e=$id(id);if(!e)return;e.focus();e.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}
 function showPlay(){if(window.dev12SetView)window.dev12SetView('play');}
 document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
   const b=e.target.closest('[data-p20-action]'); if(!b)return; const a=b.dataset.p20Action;
   if(a==='pattern'||a==='song'){if(window.dev12SetView)window.dev12SetView('patterns');}
   else if(a==='voice'){if(window.dev12SetView)window.dev12SetView('browser');}
   else if(a==='mix'){if(window.dev12SetView)window.dev12SetView('mixer');}
   else if(a==='settings'||a==='midi'){if(window.dev12SetView)window.dev12SetView('settings'); if(a==='midi')setTimeout(()=>focusId('midiChan'),80);}
   else if(a==='length'){showPlay();setTimeout(()=>focusId('patternLen'),50);}
   else if(a==='swing'){showPlay();setTimeout(()=>focusId('swing'),50);}
   else if(a==='tempo'){showPlay();setTimeout(()=>focusId('bpm'),50);}
   else if(a==='tune'){showPlay();setTimeout(()=>focusId('tune'),50);}
   else if(a==='step'||a==='quant'||a==='fill'){showPlay();setTimeout(()=>document.querySelector('.seqwrap')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'}),50);}
   else if(a==='copy')clickId('copyBarBtn');
   else if(a==='erase')clickId('clearBarBtn');
   else if(a==='play')clickId('playBtn');
   else if(a==='plus'||a==='minus'){const x=$id('bpm');if(x){x.value=Math.max(+x.min||20,Math.min(+x.max||300,+x.value+(a==='plus'?1:-1)));x.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}}
 });
 // Replace the utilitarian mixer renderer with a hardware-console renderer while preserving the same state/actions.
 window.renderMixerView=function(){
   const g=$id('mixerGrid');if(!g||!padState)return;g.innerHTML='';
   padState.forEach((p,i)=>{const v=model.voices[p.voice]||model.voices[0];const panRot=(p.pan||0)*15;const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='mixStrip';
     d.innerHTML=`<h4>${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')} · ${p.label}<br><span class="mini">${v.name}</span></h4><div class="p20Meter"></div><div class="p20PanKnob" style="--knob-rot:${panRot}deg"></div><div class="p20PanLabel">PAN ${p.pan>0?'R'+p.pan:p.pan<0?'L'+Math.abs(p.pan):'C'}</div><div class="p20FaderWell"><input data-mix="vol" data-i="${i}" type="range" min="0" max="127" value="${p.vol}" aria-label="${p.label} level"></div><div class="p20MixButtons"><button data-mix="mute" data-i="${i}">${p.mute?'UNMUTE':'MUTE'}</button><button data-mix="solo" data-i="${i}">${p.solo?'UNSOLO':'SOLO'}</button></div><input data-mix="pan" data-i="${i}" type="range" min="-3" max="3" value="${p.pan}" aria-label="${p.label} pan" style="margin-top:8px;width:100%">`;g.appendChild(d);});
   g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="vol"]').forEach(e=>e.oninput=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].vol=+e.value;if(i===selectedPad){$id('vol').value=e.value;$id('volv').textContent=e.value;}renderPads();});
   g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="pan"]').forEach(e=>e.oninput=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].pan=+e.value;const strip=e.closest('.mixStrip'),k=strip?.querySelector('.p20PanKnob'),l=strip?.querySelector('.p20PanLabel');if(k)k.style.setProperty('--knob-rot',(+e.value)*15+'deg');if(l)l.textContent='PAN '+(+e.value>0?'R'+e.value:+e.value<0?'L'+Math.abs(+e.value):'C');if(i===selectedPad){$id('pan').value=e.value;$id('panv').textContent=e.value;}});
   g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="mute"]').forEach(e=>e.onclick=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].mute=!padState[i].mute;renderMixerView();renderPads();});
   g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="solo"]').forEach(e=>e.onclick=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].solo=!padState[i].solo;renderMixerView();renderPads();});
 };
})();
</script>

</main></div><div class="appStatusbar"><span><i class="statusLed on"></i><b id="appEngineText">Audio Ready</b></span><span id="appModelText">HR-16</span><span>3 machines • sounds built in</span><span class="grow"></span><span>MIDI: <b id="appMidiText">OFF</b></span><span class="ready">● Ready</span></div></div>
<script id="pass23-shell-script">
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
 const nav=document.querySelector('.productNav');const side=document.getElementById('appSidebar');if(nav&&side)side.appendChild(nav);
 const sync=()=>{
  const mt=document.getElementById('modelTitle')?.textContent||'HR-16';
  const ms=document.getElementById('modelSub')?.textContent||'';
  const eng=document.getElementById('engineStat')?.textContent||'READY';
  const midi=document.getElementById('midiStat')?.textContent||'OFF';
  const chip=document.getElementById('appModelChip');if(chip)chip.innerHTML=`${mt} <b>${mt==='SR-16'?'12 PAD':'16 PAD'}</b>`;
  const a=document.getElementById('appModelText');if(a)a.textContent=mt;const e=document.getElementById('appEngineText');if(e)e.textContent=/FAILED|ERROR/.test(eng)?'Audio Error':(/ACTIVE|LIVE|IOS/.test(eng)?'Audio Active':'Audio Ready');const m=document.getElementById('appMidiText');if(m)m.textContent=midi.replace(/^MIDI\s*/,'')||'OFF';
 };
 sync();setInterval(sync,600);
});
</script>

<script id="pass24-web-mobile-script">
(()=>{
 const ROM_EXPECTED={hr16:{bytes:1048576,crc32:0xbd375386},hr16b:{bytes:1048576,crc32:0xf5e8f90d},sr16:{bytes:1048576,crc32:0xf37f8486}};
 const CRC_TABLE=(()=>{const t=new Uint32Array(256);for(let n=0;n<256;n++){let c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=(c>>>1)^((c&1)?0xedb88320:0);t[n]=c>>>0;}return t;})();function crc32(bytes){let c=0xffffffff;for(let i=0;i<bytes.length;i++)c=(c>>>8)^CRC_TABLE[(c^bytes[i])&255];return (c^0xffffffff)>>>0;}
 function verifyEmbeddedRoms(){
  try{
   const keys=['hr16','hr16b','sr16'];let ok=0;
   for(const k of keys){const b=b64bytes(ROM_B64[k]||'');const exp=ROM_EXPECTED[k];if(b.length===exp.bytes && crc32(b)===exp.crc32)ok++;}
   const t=document.getElementById('appRomText');if(t)t.textContent=ok===3?'BUILT IN':`${ok}/3 READY`;
   document.documentElement.dataset.romBundle=ok===3?'ok':'bad';
   return ok===3;
  }catch(e){const t=document.getElementById('appRomText');if(t)t.textContent='CHECK';return false;}
 }
 function syncPatternLength(value,source){
  const v=Math.max(16,Math.min(64,parseInt(value,10)||32));
  patternLength=v;
  const a=document.getElementById('patternLen'),b=document.getElementById('appPatternLen');
  if(a&&a!==source)a.value=String(v);if(b&&b!==source)b.value=String(v);
  if(typeof renderSeq==='function')renderSeq();
  try{localStorage.setItem('dm3ag.patternLength',String(v));}catch(_){}
 }
 function setViewportUnit(){document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--app-vh',`${(window.visualViewport?.height||window.innerHeight)*0.01}px`);}
 window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
  const a=document.getElementById('patternLen'),b=document.getElementById('appPatternLen');
  let saved=null;try{saved=localStorage.getItem('dm3ag.patternLength');}catch(_){}
  const start=['16','32','48','64'].includes(saved)?saved:(a?.value||'32');
  if(a){a.value=start;a.addEventListener('change',e=>syncPatternLength(e.target.value,e.target));}
  if(b){b.value=start;b.addEventListener('change',e=>syncPatternLength(e.target.value,e.target));}
  syncPatternLength(start,null);
  verifyEmbeddedRoms();setViewportUnit();
  window.addEventListener('resize',setViewportUnit,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange',()=>setTimeout(()=>{setViewportUnit();if(typeof renderSeq==='function')renderSeq();},120),{passive:true});
  if(window.visualViewport)window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',setViewportUnit,{passive:true});
 },{once:true});
})();
</script>

<div class="helpOverlay" id="p25Help" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="p25HelpTitle">
 <div class="helpDialog">
  <div class="helpHead"><div><h2 id="p25HelpTitle">DM3AG Rhythm Lab Help</h2><small>Quick Start, controls and shortcuts</small></div><button class="helpClose" id="p25HelpClose" aria-label="Close help">×</button></div>
  <div class="helpBody">
   <div class="helpHero">
    <section class="helpCard"><h3>QUICK START</h3><div class="helpSteps">
     <div class="helpStep"><span>Choose HR-16, HR-16B or SR-16.</span></div>
     <div class="helpStep"><span>Tap a pad once to enable audio, then audition sounds.</span></div>
     <div class="helpStep"><span>Click steps in the grid to build a pattern. Set Length to 16, 32, 48 or 64.</span></div>
     <div class="helpStep"><span>Set tempo/swing and press Play. Save Kit stores your current setup.</span></div>
    </div></section>
    <section class="helpCard"><h3>PAD & STEP EDITING</h3>
     <p><b>Pad:</b> click/tap to select and play. Right-click mutes. Shift + right-click solos.</p>
     <p><b>Step:</b> click/tap toggles. Alt/Option-click adds 50% probability. Shift-click adds a ratchet.</p>
     <p><b>Selected pad:</b> use Voice, Tune, Level and Pan below the pads.</p>
    </section>
   </div>
   <section class="helpCard"><h3>KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS</h3><div class="shortcutGrid">
    <kbd>Space</kbd><span>Play / Stop</span>
    <kbd>1–0, Q–Y</kbd><span>Trigger performance pads</span>
    <kbd>Shift + pad key</kbd><span>Trigger at maximum velocity</span>
    <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd + S</kbd><span>Save kit</span>
    <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd + Z</kbd><span>Undo</span>
    <kbd>Shift + Ctrl/Cmd + Z</kbd><span>Redo</span>
    <kbd>F1 or ?</kbd><span>Open Help</span>
    <kbd>Esc</kbd><span>Close Help / stop playback</span>
   </div></section>
   <section class="helpCard"><h3>MOBILE & BROWSER</h3><p>Portrait and landscape are supported. The step grid scrolls horizontally on smaller screens. On iPhone/iPad, tap a pad or Play once to authorize browser audio.</p></section>
   <section class="helpCard"><h3>ABOUT</h3><p>HR-16, HR-16B and SR-16 sound data are embedded in this single HTML file, so no separate sound download is required. The normal interface hides engineering diagnostics; they remain available under Settings → Technical Info.</p><div class="helpActions"><button id="p25GoSettings">OPEN SETTINGS</button><button id="p25ToggleTech">SHOW TECHNICAL INFO</button></div><p class="helpFine">Technical info is intended for troubleshooting and verification, not routine pattern creation.</p></section>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>
<div class="p25Toast" id="p25Toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script id="pass25-presentation-script">
(()=>{
 const help=()=>document.getElementById('p25Help');
 function openHelp(){const h=help();if(!h)return;h.classList.add('open');document.body.classList.add('p25HelpOpen');setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('p25HelpClose')?.focus(),0);}
 function closeHelp(){const h=help();if(!h)return;h.classList.remove('open');document.body.classList.remove('p25HelpOpen');}
 function toast(msg){const t=document.getElementById('p25Toast');if(!t)return;t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(window.__p25ToastTimer);window.__p25ToastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),1800);}
 function syncFriendlyLabels(){
  const auth=document.getElementById('authBtn'),modern=document.getElementById('modernBtn');if(auth)auth.textContent='CLASSIC';if(modern)modern.textContent='ENHANCED';
  const sa=document.getElementById('settingsAuth'),sm=document.getElementById('settingsModern');if(sa)sa.textContent='CLASSIC MODE';if(sm)sm.textContent='ENHANCED MODE';
  const adv=document.getElementById('advancedBtn');if(adv)adv.textContent=document.body.classList.contains('simpleUI')?'MORE':'LESS';
 }
 window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
  document.getElementById('helpMenuBtn')?.addEventListener('click',openHelp);
  document.getElementById('helpToolBtn')?.addEventListener('click',openHelp);
  document.getElementById('settingsHelp')?.addEventListener('click',openHelp);
  document.getElementById('p25HelpClose')?.addEventListener('click',closeHelp);
  help()?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===help())closeHelp();});
  document.getElementById('p25GoSettings')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{closeHelp();document.querySelector('.viewBtn[data-view="settings"]')?.click();});
  document.getElementById('p25ToggleTech')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.getElementById('advancedBtn')?.click();syncFriendlyLabels();toast(document.body.classList.contains('simpleUI')?'Technical info hidden':'Technical info shown');});
  document.getElementById('settingsAdvanced')?.addEventListener('click',()=>setTimeout(syncFriendlyLabels,0));
  syncFriendlyLabels();
  // Normal UI should start clean on every load; diagnostics are opt-in.
  document.body.classList.add('simpleUI');
 },{once:true});
 window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(help()?.classList.contains('open') && e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();closeHelp();return;}
  if(e.key==='F1' || (e.key==='?' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !(e.target&&/INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA/.test(e.target.tagName)))){e.preventDefault();openHelp();}
 },true);
 window.DM3AGHelp={open:openHelp,close:closeHelp};
})();
</script>

<script id="pass26-final-polish-js">
(()=>{
 let voiceCategory='all';
 const cat=v=>{const n=(v?.name||'').toLowerCase();if(n.includes('kick')||n.includes('bass drum'))return'kick';if(n.includes('snare')||n.includes('rim')||n.includes('stick'))return'snare';if(n.includes('tom'))return'tom';if(n.includes('hat'))return'hat';if(n.includes('cymbal')||n.includes('ride')||n.includes('crash'))return'cymbal';return'perc';};
 const panText=v=>v===0?'C':v<0?`L${Math.abs(v)}`:`R${v}`;
 window.renderMixerView=function(){
  const g=document.getElementById('mixerGrid');if(!g||typeof padState==='undefined'||typeof model==='undefined'||!model)return;g.innerHTML='';
  const mm=document.getElementById('p26MixModel');if(mm)mm.textContent=model.display;
  padState.forEach((p,i)=>{const v=model.voices[p.voice]||model.voices[0],d=document.createElement('div');d.className='mixStrip'+(i===selectedPad?' selected':'');
   d.innerHTML=`<h4><b>${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')} · ${p.label}</b><span>${v.name}</span></h4><div class="p26MeterRail"><i style="--level:${Math.round((p.vol||0)/127*100)}%"></i></div><label>LEVEL <input data-mix="vol" data-i="${i}" type="range" min="0" max="127" value="${p.vol}"><output>${p.vol}</output></label><label>PAN <input data-mix="pan" data-i="${i}" type="range" min="-3" max="3" value="${p.pan}"><output>${panText(p.pan)}</output></label><div class="p26Route"><span>OUT</span><select data-mix="bus" data-i="${i}"><option value="1" ${p.bus!==2?'selected':''}>OUT 1</option><option value="2" ${p.bus===2?'selected':''}>OUT 2</option></select></div><div class="p26MixButtons"><button data-mix="mute" data-i="${i}" class="${p.mute?'on':''}">${p.mute?'MUTED':'MUTE'}</button><button data-mix="solo" data-i="${i}" class="${p.solo?'on':''}">${p.solo?'SOLOED':'SOLO'}</button></div>`;g.appendChild(d);});
  g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="vol"]').forEach(e=>e.oninput=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].vol=+e.value;e.parentElement.querySelector('output').textContent=e.value;if(i===selectedPad){document.getElementById('vol').value=e.value;document.getElementById('volv').textContent=e.value;}renderPads();});
  g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="pan"]').forEach(e=>e.oninput=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].pan=+e.value;e.parentElement.querySelector('output').textContent=panText(+e.value);if(i===selectedPad){document.getElementById('pan').value=e.value;document.getElementById('panv').textContent=e.value;}renderPads();});
  g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="bus"]').forEach(e=>e.onchange=()=>{padState[+e.dataset.i].bus=+e.value;if(+e.dataset.i===selectedPad)syncEditor?.();renderPads();});
  g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="mute"]').forEach(e=>e.onclick=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].mute=!padState[i].mute;renderPads();renderMixerView();});
  g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="solo"]').forEach(e=>e.onclick=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].solo=!padState[i].solo;renderPads();renderMixerView();});
 };
 window.renderVoiceBrowser=function(){
  const list=document.getElementById('voiceList');if(!list||typeof model==='undefined'||!model)return;const q=(document.getElementById('voiceSearch')?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();list.innerHTML='';
  const bp=document.getElementById('browserPad');if(bp)bp.textContent=padState[selectedPad]?.label||'—';const bm=document.getElementById('browserModel');if(bm)bm.textContent=model.display;
  const current=model.voices[padState[selectedPad]?.voice]||null;const cv=document.getElementById('p26CurrentVoice');if(cv)cv.textContent=current?.name||'Choose a sound';
  let shown=0;model.voices.forEach((v,i)=>{const type=cat(v),hay=`${v.num} ${v.name} ${type}`.toLowerCase();if(q&&!hay.includes(q))return;if(voiceCategory!=='all'&&type!==voiceCategory)return;shown++;const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='voiceItem'+(padState[selectedPad]?.voice===i?' selected':'');d.innerHTML=`<span class="voiceNum">${String(v.num).padStart(3,'0')}</span><b>${v.name}</b><span class="voiceType">${type}</span>`;d.onclick=()=>{pushHistory?.();padState[selectedPad].voice=i;fillVoiceSelect();syncEditor();renderPads();renderVoiceBrowser();triggerPad(selectedPad,105);};list.appendChild(d);});
  const total=document.getElementById('p26VoiceCount'),side=document.getElementById('p26SidebarCount');if(total)total.textContent=`${shown} VOICES`;if(side)side.textContent=`${shown} / ${model.voices.length}`;
 };
 window.renderHistoryPatterns=function(){const g=document.getElementById('historyPatternGrid');if(!g)return;g.innerHTML='';const visible=HISTORY_PATTERNS.filter(p=>historyPatternFilter==='all'||p.genre===historyPatternFilter||(historyPatternFilter==='alesis'&&p.alesis));for(const p of visible){const ok=historyPatternValid(p),d=document.createElement('article');d.className='patternCard';d.innerHTML=`<div class="patternArtist">${p.artist}</div><h3>${p.title}</h3><div class="mini">${p.section}</div><div class="patternMeta"><span class="patternBadge verified">${ok?'READY':'UNAVAILABLE'}</span><span class="patternBadge ${p.genre}">${p.genre.toUpperCase()}</span>${p.alesis?'<span class="patternBadge alesis">ALESIS</span>':''}<span class="patternBadge">${p.bpm} BPM</span><span class="patternBadge">${p.length} STEPS</span></div>${historyPreview(p)}<div class="patternActions"><button data-loadhist="${p.id}" ${ok?'':'disabled'}>LOAD</button><button data-playhist="${p.id}" ${ok?'':'disabled'}>LOAD + PLAY</button></div><div class="patternSource">Transcription reference · ${p.sources.map((u,i)=>`<a href="${u}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${i+1}</a>`).join(' · ')}</div>`;g.appendChild(d);}g.querySelectorAll('[data-loadhist]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>loadHistoryPattern(b.dataset.loadhist,false));g.querySelectorAll('[data-playhist]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>loadHistoryPattern(b.dataset.playhist,true));const q=document.getElementById('historyResearchQueue');if(q)q.innerHTML=HISTORY_RESEARCH_QUEUE.map(x=>`<div class="queueItem"><span><b>${x[0]} — ${x[1]}</b><br>${x[2]}</span><span class="queueState">NOT YET AVAILABLE</span></div>`).join('');};
 function syncSettings(){const f=document.getElementById('analogModel'),pf=document.getElementById('p26AnalogModel');if(f&&pf)pf.checked=f.checked;const vc=document.getElementById('velCurve'),pvc=document.getElementById('p26VelCurve');if(vc&&pvc)pvc.value=vc.value;const pl=document.getElementById('patternLen'),ppl=document.getElementById('p26PatternLen');if(pl&&ppl)ppl.value=pl.value;}
 function closeMenu(){document.getElementById('p26MenuPopup')?.remove();}
 function openMenu(btn,items){closeMenu();const r=btn.getBoundingClientRect(),p=document.createElement('div');p.id='p26MenuPopup';p.className='appMenuPopup';for(const it of items){if(it.sep){const s=document.createElement('div');s.className='sep';p.appendChild(s);continue;}const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=it.label;b.onclick=()=>{closeMenu();it.action();};p.appendChild(b);}document.body.appendChild(p);p.style.left=Math.min(r.left,innerWidth-p.offsetWidth-8)+'px';p.style.top=(r.bottom+2)+'px';}
 window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('.voiceFilter').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{voiceCategory=b.dataset.vcat||'all';document.querySelectorAll('.voiceFilter').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));renderVoiceBrowser();}));
  document.getElementById('p26ResetMix')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{pushHistory?.();padState.forEach(p=>{p.vol=112;p.pan=0;p.bus=1;p.mute=false;p.solo=false;});renderPads();renderMixerView();syncEditor?.();});
  document.getElementById('p26MuteAll')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const all=padState.every(p=>p.mute);padState.forEach(p=>p.mute=!all);renderPads();renderMixerView();});
  document.getElementById('p26AnalogModel')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{const x=document.getElementById('analogModel');if(x)x.checked=e.target.checked;});
  document.getElementById('p26VelCurve')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{const x=document.getElementById('velCurve');if(x){x.value=e.target.value;x.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}});
  document.getElementById('p26PatternLen')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{const x=document.getElementById('patternLen');if(x){x.value=e.target.value;x.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}});
  const oldSet=window.dev12SetView;window.dev12SetView=function(v){oldSet(v);if(v==='settings')syncSettings();if(v==='browser')renderVoiceBrowser();if(v==='mixer')renderMixerView();};
  syncSettings();
  const menuDefs={File:[{label:'Save Kit',action:()=>document.getElementById('saveKitBtn')?.click()},{label:'Load Kit…',action:()=>document.getElementById('loadKitBtn')?.click()}],Edit:[{label:'Undo',action:()=>document.getElementById('undoBtn')?.click()},{label:'Redo',action:()=>document.getElementById('redoBtn')?.click()},{sep:true},{label:'Clear Current Bar',action:()=>document.getElementById('clearBarBtn')?.click()}],View:[{label:'Machine',action:()=>dev12SetView('play')},{label:'Mixer',action:()=>dev12SetView('mixer')},{label:'Voices',action:()=>dev12SetView('browser')},{label:'Patterns',action:()=>dev12SetView('patterns')},{label:'Settings',action:()=>dev12SetView('settings')}],Tools:[{label:'Enable MIDI',action:()=>document.getElementById('midiBtn')?.click()},{label:'Technical Info',action:()=>document.getElementById('advancedBtn')?.click()}]};
  document.querySelectorAll('.appMenubar .menuBtn').forEach(btn=>{const key=btn.textContent.trim();if(menuDefs[key])btn.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();openMenu(btn,menuDefs[key]);});});
  document.addEventListener('click',closeMenu);window.addEventListener('resize',closeMenu);
 });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
